categories.name: Any%
categories.rules:
• Timing starts when first movement is possible. If the menu is opened before movement is possible, timing starts on opening the menu.

• Timing ends when the first gem appears after the last hit on Gnasty Gnorc. No you don't have to see the credits if you die on last hit :)

General Submission Rules: [https://www.speedrun.com/series/spyro/forums/o05u8](https://www.speedrun.com/series/spyro/forums/o05u8)

• Timing starts when first movement is possible. If the menu is opened before movement is possible, timing starts on opening the menu.

• Timing ends on the black screen after entering the "Return Home" vortex in Loot before the 120% cutscene.

• Collecting all 12 eggs, all 80 dragons, and all 14000 gems (a complete inventory) is required prior to entering the loot vortex to complete the run.

General Submission Rules: [https://www.speedrun.com/series/spyro/forums/o05u8](https://www.speedrun.com/series/spyro/forums/o05u8)

categories.name: Flight
categories.rules:
• Complete the flight. In-game timer is used.
• Pausing during the flight is not allowed.

General Submission Rules: [https://www.speedrun.com/series/spyro/forums/o05u8](https://www.speedrun.com/series/spyro/forums/o05u8)

categories.name: Vortex
categories.rules:
• Timing starts when first movement is possible. If the menu is opened before movement is possible, timing starts on opening the menu.

• Timing ends when the first gem appears after the last hit on Gnasty Gnorc.

• You must leave through every "Return Home" portal in the game (excluding Gnasty's Loot).

• Use of In-Game cheat codes is allowed.

General Submission Rules: [https://www.speedrun.com/series/spyro/forums/o05u8](https://www.speedrun.com/series/spyro/forums/o05u8)

categories.name: Cheat%
categories.rules:
• Timing starts when first movement is possible. If the menu is opened before movement is possible, timing starts on opening the menu.

• Timing ends when the first gem appears after the last hit on Gnasty Gnorc.

• Use of In-Game cheat codes is allowed.

• Since the game records at 60fps, final times that require milliseconds will end in one of the following increments: .x00, .x17 (or .x16), .x33 (or .x34), .x50, .x67 (or .x66), or .x83 (or .x84).

General Submission Rules: [https://www.speedrun.com/series/spyro/forums/o05u8](https://www.speedrun.com/series/spyro/forums/o05u8)

categories.name: 80 Dragons
categories.rules:
• Timing starts when first movement is possible. If the menu is opened before movement is possible, timing starts on opening the menu.

• Timing ends when the dragon counter flips to 80.

General Submission Rules: [https://www.speedrun.com/series/spyro/forums/o05u8](https://www.speedrun.com/series/spyro/forums/o05u8)

categories.name: True Ending
categories.rules:
• Timing starts when first movement is possible. If the menu is opened before movement is possible, timing starts on opening the menu.

• Timing ends on the black screen after entering the "Return Home" vortex in Loot before the 120% cutscene.

• You must have an incomplete inventory prior to entering the loot vortex and triggering the 120% cutscene.

General Submission Rules: [https://www.speedrun.com/series/spyro/forums/o05u8](https://www.speedrun.com/series/spyro/forums/o05u8)

happy to report that this category is kinda sick

Played on ps2 console (model 79001)

This run completes my latest silly goal. As of this run, I am currently the only person who has a top 10 time in the three most run categories: 120%, Any%, and Vortex%. I have other games I would also like to run, but if I can get back to it before too long, I would like to continue my top 10s into 80 Dragons, Cheat%, and Pseudo 120%, which would be all of the current main leaderboards.

I also don't expect this to remain true for very long. Any% and Vortex are both plenty active, and I could lose my top 10 spot in either of them any day. I am not the only person who has ever had top 10 in these three categories (although I believe I am in the time since Vortex really blew up). This community is full of very good players who care a lot about this game. My times now are good, and I will still improve them, but I will eventually be overtaken. That's just part of speedrunning, and part of life.
